title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1972-12-12
lineage: SBD > MR (7 inch @ 7.5ips 1/2trk) > DAT > Sony TCD-D8 > RME Hammerfall Digiface > Sony Vaio C1VP > Samplitude v7.02 Professional > Cool Edit Pro v2.0 > FLAC16

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording captures the high‑energy 12/12/72 show with standout Bird Song, In The Band, The Other One and a sparkling Keith Godchaux mix.
ai_review.review: The Miller soundboard source “sparkles” from start to finish, delivering a clear mix where Keith’s inventive piano is front‑and‑center.  The performance is a classic early‑’72 set – tight rhythm sections, soaring Bird Song, powerful In The Band/Other One medley and generous second‑set jams that keep the energy high throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate 4–5 stars, praising both the musical performance and the soundboard quality; only minor technical quirks are noted.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp and clear overall with Keith Godchaux very audible. A small splice is mentioned early in Cumberland Blues, and a few listeners wish the bass was louder, but no major drop‑outs or distortion.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Relaxed yet focused; first set solid, second set builds into extended jams that keep momentum high.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia described as "on fire" with soaring tone and great solos throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass work praised as solid; several listeners note it could be turned up a bit for more presence.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob Weir’s voice is noted as hoarse/frog‑like, adding character; occasional cracks mentioned but not detrimental.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith Godchaux called inventive and very audible in the mix, contributing greatly to the show’s sparkle.
